Command: A man shall not wear a woman's garment
Summary: One half of the Deuteronomy 22:5 distinction: a man shall not wear a woman's garment.
Commandment: A man shall not wear a woman's garment
Application: Scripture's stated ground: for all that do so are abomination unto the LORD thy God (Deuteronomy 22:5). Debated: whether the verse binds specific garments today or the broader distinction it expresses is a genuine difference of reading — this row does not settle it.
Purpose: Scripture's stated ground: for all that do so are abomination unto the LORD thy God (Deuteronomy 22:5).
